highlights: Anker Soundcore Select 4 Go Portable Bluetooth Speaker
Soundcore Select 4 Go Bluetooth Speaker - Ultra-Portable, Powerful Sound for Outdoor Adventures
Get ready to take your music anywhere with the Soundcore Select 4 Go Bluetooth Speaker by Anker.
This ultra-portable, high-performance speaker is designed for the ultimate outdoor experience, offering premium sound quality, long-lasting battery life, and rugged durability.

Hi-Res Sound Mode & Stereo Sound Mode: Whether you're at a beach party, hiking, or just relaxing outdoors, enjoy Hi-Res and Stereo Sound Modes for crystal-clear, immersive audio with deep bass and sharp treble.
Ultra-Portable: Compact, lightweight, and easy to carry, the Select 4 Go is perfect for on-the-go use.
Take it on your next adventure, whether you're biking, hiking, or enjoying a day at the beach.
IP67 Waterproof & Dustproof: Built to withstand tough conditions, the speaker is fully waterproof and dustproof, making it ideal for outdoor activities in any weather.
Floatable Design: Not only is the Soundcore Select 4 Go waterproof, but it also floats, so you don’t have to worry about it sinking if dropped in water during your river party or poolside gathering.
Up to 20 Hours of Playtime: Enjoy up to 20 hours of continuous playback on a single charge, ensuring that your music never stops during your outdoor adventures.
Bass Boost: With Bass Boost technology, this speaker amplifies low frequencies for deep, rich bass, adding extra punch to your music.
